paper_title: Brief antibiotic use drives human gut bacteria towards low-cost resistance
skip_reason: This paper studies ciprofloxacin-driven evolution of antimicrobial resistance in gut commensals of 60 healthy human participants. There is no disease group compared against a healthy control. The study is a treatment intervention (antibiotic exposure) that tracks within-microbiome genetic changes — specifically selective sweeps and gyrA mutations in commensal bacteria — not a disease-vs-control microbiome composition study. The qualification gate requires comparison of a disease group vs. healthy control, which is absent here.
